audience: accounting teams with licensed A-Cube Italy API access

useCases.title: Review invoice delivery
useCases.text: Find invoices and read their SDI acceptance or rejection notifications.

useCases.title: Review electronic receipts
useCases.text: Find receipts for a selected business and inspect a chosen receipt.

useCases.title: Validate an invoice draft
useCases.text: Check supplied invoice content without saving or transmitting it.

useCases.title: Prepare an agreed draft
useCases.text: Save invoice content as a draft without sending it to the SDI.

useCases.title: Submit an approved draft
useCases.text: Preview the selected draft, then submit only with explicit confirmation. Acceptance does not prove SDI delivery and vendor charges may apply.
